mapper.select: SELECT * FROM woodfactory1 WHERE clas=#{clas} ORDER BY (rawInventory+goodsInventory) / totalInventory DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders ( generationtime, startlatitude, startlongitude, endlatitude, endlongitude, goodid, goodcount, startfactoryid, startfactoryname, endfactoryid, endfactoryname, carid ) VALUES ( #{generation_time}, #{startlatitude}, #{startlongitude}, #{endlatitude}, #{endlongitude}, #{goodid}, #{goodcount}, #{startfactoryid}, #{startfactoryname}, #{endfactoryid}, #{endfactoryname}, #{carid} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM car WHERE isready = 1 ORDER BY `load` DESC

SELECT o.id AS order_id, o.state AS order_state, o.generationtime AS order_generationtime, o.startfactoryid AS order_startfactoryid, o.startfactoryname AS order_startfactoryname, o.startlatitude AS order_startlatitude, o.startlongitude AS order_startlongitude, o.endfactoryid AS order_endfactoryid, o.endfactoryname AS order_endfactoryname, o.endlatitude AS order_endlatitude, o.endlongitude AS order_endlongitude, o.carid AS order_carid, o.goodid AS order_goodid, o.goodcount AS order_goodcount, c.id AS car_id, c.type AS car_type, c.load AS car_load, c.latitude AS car_latitude, c.longitude AS car_longitude, w1.id AS start_factory_id, w1.name AS start_factory_name, w1.address AS start_factory_address, w1.latitude AS start_factory_latitude, w1.longitude AS start_factory_longitude, w1.clas AS start_factory_clas, w1.goodsID AS start_factory_goodsID, w1.rawInventory AS start_factory_rawInventory, w1.goodsInventory AS start_factory_goodsInventory, w1.totalInventory AS start_factory_totalInventory, w1.transRate AS start_factory_transRate, w1.speedRate AS start_factory_speedRate, w1.rawID AS start_factory_rawID, w2.id AS end_factory_id, w2.name AS end_factory_name, w2.address AS end_factory_address, w2.latitude AS end_factory_latitude, w2.longitude AS end_factory_longitude, w2.clas AS end_factory_clas, w2.goodsID AS end_factory_goodsID, w2.rawInventory AS end_factory_rawInventory, w2.goodsInventory AS end_factory_goodsInventory, w2.totalInventory AS end_factory_totalInventory, w2.transRate AS end_factory_transRate, w2.speedRate AS end_factory_speedRate, w2.rawID AS end_factory_rawID FROM ( SELECT * FROM orders WHERE state = 0) o LEFT JOIN car c ON o.carid = c.id LEFT JOIN woodfactory1 w1 ON o.startfactoryid = w1.id LEFT JOIN woodfactory1 w2 ON o.endfactoryid = w2.id
